# Contributing

Welcome! Before opening a pull request or raising an issue, please take a moment to review our [Best Practices Guide](https://github.com/Zenith-Xperience/.github/blob/main/.github/BEST_PRACTICES.md). It covers our GitHub workflow, PR guidelines, the PR & QA verification process, code quality standards, and more.

## Opening a Pull Request

- Use the PR template - it's applied automatically when you open a PR.
- Keep PRs small and focused (see the Best Practices Guide for size guidelines).
- Once your PR is merged, move the ticket to the **QA Verification** column yourself.
- Never include secrets, API keys, or credentials in a PR description or diff - see the Secrets & Credentials section of the Best Practices Guide.

## Raising an Issue

Choose the issue template that matches what you're reporting:

- **Defect Report** - general bugs found during QA or development.
- **UI Defect Report** - visual/UI mismatches against the Figma design.
- **QA Verification** - used as a sub-issue to verify a merged PR (or a fixed defect) on a live environment.

## Questions?

If anything is unclear, check the [Best Practices Guide](https://github.com/Zenith-Xperience/.github/blob/main/.github/BEST_PRACTICES.md) first, then reach out to your PM or lead.
